archival_memory.espresso_machine_features: Some espresso machines come with additional features like steam wands for frothing milk or automatic cleaning systems. These can enhance the user experience and make it easier to create café-quality drinks at home.
archival_memory.espresso_machine_types: Espresso machines can be categorized into manual and automatic types. Manual machines require more user interaction and offer a more traditional brewing experience. Automatic machines are more convenient and often come with additional features like built-in grinders, temperature control, and programmable brewing options.
